title: Mineus
summary: Raleigh names Mineus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Mineus, the founder of Memphis, whom Iosephus sets before the thirtie and eight Aegyptian Kings. He is not identified with Menes. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVIII, §. III, sig. 305b
